metricNotes.minutes: Summed lineup position intervals; estimates based on StatsBomb event timelines.
metricNotes.goals: Goal outcomes on shot events; own goals excluded.
metricNotes.assists: Goal shots with a linked key pass.
metricNotes.xG: Sum of StatsBomb shot-level expected goals.
metricNotes.xA: Approximation: sum of linked shot xG credited to the player making the key pass.
metricNotes.passes: All pass events, including unsuccessful attempts.
metricNotes.completedPasses: Pass events without a recorded unsuccessful outcome.
metricNotes.passCompletionPct: Completed passes divided by all pass attempts, multiplied by 100.
metricNotes.keyPasses: Passes linked to a shot event.
metricNotes.ballRecoveries: Ball Recovery events excluding explicitly marked failures.
metricNotes.progressiveCarries: Provisional: carries whose end x-coordinate advances at least 10 pitch units. Validate attacking direction before analysis.
